contracts.blurb: Members buy titled bungalows and pay by stage as each one stands.
Two-bedroom homes for teachers, built to the same tested standard.
Alhaji Sani's land, your blocks and your discipline: 200 homes with clean papers.
Homes for nurses, paid stage by stage, keys handed over on time.
Your first estate outside Nigeria, with local surveyors and local title.
Buyers abroad choose titled flats in your Lagos and Abuja towers.

belt.name: Wheelbarrow Train
belt.blurb: A motor barrow carries sand and cement from the gate to the block machine by itself.

auto.name: Site Forklift
auto.blurb: Moves pallets of cured blocks and bundles of rods to any plot that is waiting.

pack.name: Tower Crane
pack.blurb: Lifts materials to every plot and tower floor; you direct and collect.

milestones.title: Second Site
milestones.blurb: A second yard opens. Same rich mix, same clean papers.

milestones.title: Five Sites
milestones.blurb: Builders across Lagos and Ogun ask for Oke-Ile blocks by name.

milestones.title: Abuja Office
milestones.blurb: Alhaji Sani's land meets your discipline. The first Abuja estate is pegged out.

milestones.title: Every Region
milestones.blurb: Estates in the North, East and South-South, each with its own title desk.

milestones.title: Every Pour Tested
milestones.blurb: Fifty sites, and every stage passed its inspection before buyers paid.

milestones.title: Across Africa
milestones.blurb: Accra and Nairobi towers rise with local engineers and local permits.

milestones.title: Skyline
milestones.blurb: Cranes in six cities carry the Oke-Ile flag.

milestones.title: Mama's Key
milestones.blurb: Dele walks his mum to her own front door and hands her one key.

staff: Tipper don land with sharp sand!
Mix am rich, make the block ring like bell.
Blocks are curing, no touch for three days.
Roof sheets are up before the rain.
Title file is stamped and in the cabinet.
Mini flat in Yaba, ready to show.
Rods for floor six, coming up on the crane.
Caution money back to Mrs Ade, in full.
customer: Can I see the title before I pay?
I want a mini flat near the bus stop.
Your blocks no dey break. I want two loads.
So I pay only when each stage stands?
Is the road inside the estate tarred?
My sister in London saw your papers online.
Fair fee, five percent. I will tell my friends.
When will the roof go up?
Do you have a shop in the plaza for my bakery?
Thank you. I got my caution money back.
manager: Every site passed its last inspection, sir.
Cement is cheap this week. Shall we fill the store?
The loan balance is down after the roof payment.
Two plaza shops are let for the year.
All 20 plots have their title files.
The tower is on schedule. Engineer signed off.
night: One ring of borrowed keys. Look at us now.
Tomorrow I check the cement store first.
Mama, your key is coming. Clean papers.
Sell now or let for the year? Let me think.
Block wey no strong na biscuit. Mama Risi was right.

events.name: Cement Price Jump
events.text: Cement adds ₦1,500 a bag this week. Building costs more today.

events.name: Rainy Day
events.text: Heavy rain. Blocks cure slowly and the tipper is stuck. Fewer customers today.

events.name: Diaspora Buyer Calls
events.text: A buyer abroad saw your clean papers online and tells friends. More buyers today.

events.name: Surprise Site Inspection
events.text: Your permit and stage certificate are on the wall. Passed! Word spreads.

events.name: Concrete Test Passed
events.text: The cube test came back strong. Bricklayers work faster for the rest of the day.

events.name: Tenant Referral
events.text: A happy tenant got her caution money back and sent three friends to your desk.

events.name: Tipper Breakdown
events.text: The tipper has a flat tyre on the expressway. Deliveries are slow today.

events.name: Plaza Shop Fit-out Grant
events.text: The estate residents' fund pays for new street lights at the plaza.

mech.name: Hand carry
mech.how: Cement bags and blocks carried on the shoulder from the gate

mech.name: Wheelbarrow
mech.how: A green wheelbarrow of blocks rolls along a plank path

mech.name: Wheelbarrow train
mech.how: Three wheelbarrows hooked behind a tiny motor cart with a yellow lamp

mech.name: Tipper
mech.how: A second-hand tipper tips sharp sand and stacks of bags at the yard gate

mech.name: Site forklift
mech.how: An orange forklift with a flashing beacon moves pallets of blocks to the plots

mech.name: Tower crane
mech.how: A yellow lattice crane with a red hook lifts rods and glass to every floor

storyNote: Story follows plan2/estate.json. Chief Bambo's cheap land with no papers appears only as a rival's line; land claim scenes are settled by the title file and are shown as a calm event, with no named groups. No fake titles, double sales or land grabbing exist in the game.
